name: Gatam
title: Chieftain of Edom
summary: Gatam was one of the sons of Eliphaz, who was the firstborn son of Esau. He became a chieftain among the Edomites and is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles. He represents part of Esau's descendants who settled in the mountains of Seir.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as a son of Eliphaz
keyEvents.description: Gatam is listed as one of the sons of Eliphaz, Esau's firstborn son, in the genealogy of Esau's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Chieftain in Edom
keyEvents.description: Gatam is mentioned as one of the tribal chiefs among the descendants of Eliphaz in the land of Edom, indicating his position as a leader among the Edomites.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Gatam is mentioned again in the genealogies of Chronicles as one of Eliphaz's sons, confirming his place in Esau's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Esau's Settlement in Seir
keyEvents.description: As part of Esau's descendants, Gatam was associated with the settlement in the mountains of Seir, where the Edomites established themselves as a distinct people separate from the descendants of Jacob.
